name: Exit interview themes summary
summary: Each quarter or half-year, your HR lead sees what leavers said on the way out: themes with counts, unattributed quotes with identifying detail removed, set beside the reasons recorded at the time, and questions for leadership. Small groups are combined or withheld by a stated rule. It decides nothing about any person.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method for summarising exit interviews: the company's leaver list, notes and forms as the only evidence, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, themes counted by leaver beside the reasons recorded at the time, a fixed anonymity rule for groups, themes and quotes, matters for HR's own process set aside, and nothing decided about any person.
